title: Influence of Neuromuscular Training Interventions on Jump-Landing Biomechanics and Implications for ACL Injuries in Youth Females: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis.

adjudication.design_quote: Thirteen studies (7 randomised controlled, 6 non-randomised controlled studies) involving 648 female participants were included in the final analyses.
